scope: Step4 reference adequacy only, prospective algorithm after stage3 diagnostics; not blind confirmation. Efficiency resampling protocol remains to be frozen before efficiency calculation.
domain: bins wholly within [0.9,5.5], shell-volume weights normalized; angular weights 1/128
reference: equal average of two EDH seed means
uncertainty: weighted RMS standard error from sum of seed block variances / (4*nblocks); also Gaussian centered-block multiplier 95th percentile norm of reference error with 2000 draws; use full covariance through weighted Gram matrix
compatibility: weighted RMS seed1 minus seed2 compared to centered Gaussian block multiplier null difference, two-sided via norm upper tail; p=(1+count(null>=observed))/2001; exploratory diagnostic p<.05 flag per channel/block, all reported
adequacy_rule: 95th percentile reference error norm / norm(reference) < target/3 at all four blocks; report any compatibility flags and lack of stable block errors; no efficiency savings claim if unresolved
limits: Gaussian multiplier/block independence approximation, not guaranteed confidence coverage; two seeds cannot establish universal reference validity. No test data or EFS used.
